customSections.label: CCSD Calendar 2026-2027 Spanish Version
customSections.content: Clark County School District also publishes a Spanish version of the 2026-2027 student calendar. Families who prefer Spanish can use the official Spanish PDF for the same school-year planning topics, including holidays, breaks, staff development days, contingency days, and student calendar dates.

seoTitle: CCSD Calendar 2026-2027: Holidays, Breaks, PDF & Important Dates
seoDescription: View the CCSD Calendar 2026-2027 with first day of school, holidays, winter break, spring break, PDF download, ICS calendar file, and important dates for Clark County families.
calendarNotes: Clark County School District lists 180 student days for 2026-2027. Classes begin on August 10, 2026 and the school year ends on May 20, 2027. Winter Break begins at the end of the day on December 18, with no school December 21, 2026 through January 1, 2027; classes resume January 5, 2027 after the January 4 staff development day. Spring Break begins at the end of the day on March 12, with no school March 15-19 and classes resuming March 22. CCSD also publishes a Spanish student calendar for 2026-2027.

calendarFaqs.q: When does CCSD start school in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Clark County School District starts classes on Monday, August 10, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: When is CCSD Winter Break in 2026-2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break begins at the end of the day on December 18, 2026. No school is scheduled December 21, 2026 through January 1, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: When is CCSD Spring Break in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break begins at the end of the day on March 12, 2027. No school is scheduled March 15-19, and classes resume March 22.

calendarFaqs.q: Does CCSD publish a Spanish calendar for 2026-2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. Clark County School District publishes a Spanish version of the 2026-2027 student calendar, linked as an alternate calendar.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for CCSD in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: The last day of school is Thursday, May 20, 2027.

yearNumbers.label: Longest Break
yearNumbers.detail: Winter Break is the longest predictable closure window on the 2026-2027 CCSD student calendar.

yearNumbers.label: Semester Transition
yearNumbers.detail: Students return after Winter Break on January 5, 2027, following the January 4 staff development day.

yearNumbers.label: Contingency Dates
yearNumbers.detail: The calendar lists contingency dates that may be used if CCSD needs to recover instructional time.
